title: 5.5 Non-Infectious Diseases
description: Non-infectious diseases, their causes, and prevention

questions.question: What is a non-infectious disease?
options: A disease caused by bacteria or viruses
A disease that is not caused by pathogens; it may be caused by malnutrition, chemical effects, or genetic factors
A disease that can spread from person to person
questions.answer: A disease that is not caused by pathogens; it may be caused by malnutrition, chemical effects, or genetic factors

options: Tobacco use, physical inactivity, harmful use of alcohol, and unhealthy diets
questions.answer: Tobacco use, physical inactivity, harmful use of alcohol, and unhealthy diets

questions.question: Which non-infectious disease is the leading cause of premature death worldwide?
What are the main causes of non-infectious diseases?
options: Malnutrition, chemical effects, inherited or genetic factors, and lifestyle choices
questions.answer: Malnutrition, chemical effects, inherited or genetic factors, and lifestyle choices

How can the risk of non-infectious diseases be reduced?
options: Through detection, screening, treatment, and palliative care, as well as healthy lifestyle choices
By avoiding all contact with other people
questions.answer: Through detection, screening, treatment, and palliative care, as well as healthy lifestyle choices
